completionEvidence.description: The real model selected through the WSL Model Broker settled normally and executed vm_screenshot, vm_type_text, vm_keypress and vm_screenshot in Pi RPC.
The guest file /tmp/aib-real-model-ok contained exactly '你好-real-model\n'; both expected and actual SHA256 were 1e17f29a0ab082c3118dc545968ae5049274cb291e4324fe955487bf350768d0.
The final guest-agent screenshot visibly contains the executed Chinese command in XFCE Terminal.

The guest models.json was copied back and checked locally: it contains only mock and broker providers and does not contain the upstream any-llm API key. The VM used http://10.0.2.2:6719/v1 with a local broker token.

notes: This is one real-model task, not a success-rate baseline. The full acceptance task set, cancellation under real model load, long sessions and repeated runs are still required before freezing Pi as the only CUA engine.
